remarks: Fabulous freshly painted townhome with quality throughout has 9' ceilings, an open floorplan, finished lower level and is just 2 blocks to stores and train. Conveniently located, Hatfield Mews is an elegant Georgian style, private community of 16 units with spectacular landscaping. The beautifully updated kitchen conveniently opens to the dining and living areas. Here you will relax next to the cozy fireplace and built-ins while a wall of French doors provide a bright atmosphere and gorgeous views to your private terrace with a stunning flowering garden. The primary bedroom has ample closets and exquisitely updated bathroom with oversize glass shower. The second spacious bedroom (currently used as office) also has plenty of closet space, a wall of custom built-in cabinetry and shelving, and ensuite bathroom. The finished lower level has new carpeting and offers space for an office/gym/family room and more. A separate laundry room, complete with a double sink, also has a large storage area. There is convenient parking directly in front of your unit or in the detached garage. Monthly common charges include R.E. taxes, maintenance, building insurance, water, and sewer. Taxes, ownership percentage and square footage are approximate.
